get_pybind11_version: run python -m pybind11 --version to print the pybind11 package version and exit
get_pybind11_includes: run python -m pybind11 --includes to print compiler include flags for pybind11 and Python headers
get_pybind11_cmakedir: run python -m pybind11 --cmakedir to print the CMake module directory for setting -Dpybind11_ROOT
get_pybind11_pkgconfigdir: run python -m pybind11 --pkgconfigdir to print the pkgconfig directory for setting PKG_CONFIG_PATH
get_pybind11_extension_suffix: run python -m pybind11 --extension-suffix to print the extension suffix for a Python module
